fit_linear_references: fit linear element references for target properties using a dataset and least squares regression
create_element_references: create a LinearReferences module from a .pt or .npz file containing element reference coefficients
load_references_from_config: load element references from a config dictionary with optional dataset fitting and checkpoint directory
apply_refs_dereference: apply or remove linear element references from target tensors using a LinearReferences module and AtomicData batch
compute_references: compute element-wise reference values for a batch using scatter reduce and subtract or add operations
